messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy #R-3642] Scheduled config-only rollout for config commit `cfg-2026-03-14-17` to infra cluster `dedicated-1`.

deploy-bot: Changes: routing policy -> \"latency-prefer\", batch_window_ms 20 -> 12, per_route_timeout_ms 18000 -> 16000, max_inflight 120 -> 96. Canary 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 3m steps.

maria: Holding — we have a sales demo at 15:10 in EU. Can we delay global to 15:30 UTC quiet window? @sanjay FYI.

aj: ack. We can start EU-only at 15:30 and stagger US after +30m. Canary steps: 5m at 2%, 5m at 10%, 10m at 30%, then full. Keep auto-rollback triggers.

sanjay: prefer pinning to config tag `cfg-2026-03-14-17` and pin model variant `redwood-rlhf-v2` for the canary to avoid cross-variant regressions.

olivia: noted. Observability: watch `infra.p99.latency`, `service.error_rate`, `batch.size.avg`. Drill-in dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/infra/canary?org=eng

kevin: Add note: if error_rate spikes > 2.5% for 3 consecutive minutes, deploy-bot should auto-rollback. If latency p99 increases >20% for 5m, pause and notify infra-oncall.

maria: Rollback playbook: 1) revert config commit `cfg-2026-03-14-17` (git ops), 2) scale dedicated-1 to previous capacity, 3) open incident channel #incidents and ping oncall.

aj: Config snippet in release notes:
```json
{
  \"routing_policy\": \"latency-prefer\",
  \"batch_window_ms\": 12,
  \"max_inflight\": 96,
  \"per_route_timeout_ms\": 16000,
  \"canary_steps\": [2,10,30,100]
}
```

deploy-bot: Release notes published: https://redwood.internal/releases/3642109876 (internal). Auto-rollback: enabled (error_rate>2.5% 3m OR p99>20% 5m). Change window: 15:30-16:30 UTC.

action-items:
- aj: kick EU canary at 15:30 UTC
- olivia: monitor dashboards and post updates
- kevin: stand by for rollback

sanjay: please add a short note in the release notes about why we lowered `batch_window_ms` (reduce tail latency on short-prompt workloads).

maria: confirmed. Starting canary at 15:30. tagging: @deploy-bot please run with `--graceful` flag and keep logs verbose.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Will start canary at 3642111000 (15:30 UTC). Will post status updates every step. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks — I'll be online for the whole window.

olivia: same. will post a snapshot at each step.

maria: if all green after 45m we proceed to full. otherwise rollback.

aj: perfect. updating the internal release page with the exact timeline now.
